title: FrankenRobotics Gate Registry (frob.gates/1)
description: Single schema for registries/gates.toml: first-commit BD-002 layout extended additively by N38b-18 (base record, seven closed claims, seven reconciled statuses, kill-row exemption) and N40-01 (register layer, nine rules, ten write-time refusals, receipt path receipts/gates/<hash>.json, optional sources per NAB-10, pilot scope grammar per N38a-09). Status reconciliation is recorded in docs/adr/ADR-GAUNT-04.md.
$comment: ADR: docs/adr/ADR-GAUNT-04.md. VALIDATOR CONTRACT (enforced by N40-01 in frob_conformance::register::{validate,write}): (1) claim takes one of the seven closed strings on admission/convergence/program rows; 'method' and 'Performance of the method' are rejected (claim-not-one-of-seven). (2) status is the reconciled union of seven values per ADR-GAUNT-04: not-run (printed 'not run', never passed), pass, fail (requires measured + commit + command + resolving receipt under receipts/gates/<hash>.json), killed (names kill gate or program bet, adopted fallback, and ADR in detail -> killed-without-decision), blocked (names OPEN-... or 'claim-reading: <bead>' in detail -> blocked-without-question), no-claim (terminal, valid only for claim='reality' with non-empty detail -> no-claim-on-non-reality), superseded (names existing successor gate in detail). (3) pass is refused in four cases: (a) controls is empty (pass-without-control); (b) any listed due control was not caught in the same run (control-not-caught); (c) recorded.session is a member of recorded.implemented_by (self-certified); (d) an evidence item or claim_id (parsed via frob_core::graph_id::ClaimId) does not resolve, or part.receipt does not name a committed receipts/gates/<hash>.json hashing to <hash> (evidence-unresolved). (4) measured is never empty or byte-equal to threshold (target-as-measurement). (5) Gate identifiers are unique and append-only (duplicate-id, reused-id). (6) needs='import-lane' requires claim='reality' and excludes the gate from every exit due set; blocks_exit=false is valid only on kind='admission'. (7) kind='kill' rows measure nothing and must never carry claim, claim_id, threshold, tier, controls, or [[gate.part]]. (8) Additive top-level tables [[amendment]] (N40-03), [[shared_fixture]]/[[related_threshold]] (N40-08), [[fallback_exit]] (N40-32), [[variant]] (N40-33) are admitted additively; unknown top-level tables fail load.

retired_ids.description: Tombstoned retired gate identifiers that may never be reused (INV-GAUNT-07).

amendment.description: Dated kill-gate amendments (additive top-level table owned by N40-03).

shared_fixture.description: Shared fixture declarations (additive top-level table owned by N40-08).

related_threshold.description: Related threshold cross-links (additive top-level table owned by N40-08).

fallback_exit.description: Fallback exit specifications (additive top-level table owned by N40-32).

variant.description: Milestone exit variants (additive top-level table owned by N40-33 / N40-34).

gate_kind.description: Gate row kind (admission, convergence, program, kill; kill rows carry no measurement fields).

needs_kind.description: Measurement environment requirement (N40-01): simulator (default) or import-lane (requires claim='reality' and excluded from exit due sets).

claim_kind.description: Closed set of seven claim kinds; 'method' and 'Performance of the method' are rejected and require explicit edit to 'design-comparison'.

part_status.description: Reconciled union of seven per-part statuses per docs/adr/ADR-GAUNT-04.md.

implemented_by.description: Sorted, comma-joined session identifiers of all implementers; pass is refused if recorded.session is a member (self-certified).

scope.description: Part scope description; 'pilot: <PILOT-id>' must match N38a-09 pilot ID grammar and remain status='not-run'.

measured.description: Measured value with unit/interval or count; never empty or byte-equal to threshold on pass/fail.

receipt.description: 64-hex BLAKE3 digest naming committed receipts/gates/<hash>.json (or receipt-set).

sources.description: Optional source-register citations (SRC-... with optional #figure suffix; NAB-10).
